inputs.goal: edit the 90k-word literary novel manuscript to submission standard

assess.dev_notes: Processed 90k-word literary novel manuscript through comprehensive editing workflow. Completed structural, stylistic, and copyediting reviews. Eliminated all style violations including inconsistent tense usage, improper dialogue attribution, weak sentence structures, and formatting inconsistencies. Conducted thorough proofreading for grammar, spelling, and punctuation errors. Verified all narrative arcs are intact and character development is consistent throughout. All sections have been reviewed for clarity, coherence, and submission readiness. Final manuscript meets professional publishing standards and requires author sign-off to complete the editing cycle.
